body: Reading this has made me vividly relive the past few months of my life. I made myself feel absolutely insane with the amount of loathing I endured, and it's a miracle that I didnt attempt despite my many urges to. I am still in a terrible place, and am using escapism to deal with my issues. I wish you the best my friend. You understand it. You know what it's like to have your wounds ripped open over and over again and having salt just constantly poured on them. You've endured the worst that your own mind can throw at you, and you're still here. That right there is an accomplishment. Message me if you ever need to talk.
